trust_decision.summary: Decided: the whole trust boundary is an exact-match check on the query-parameter KEY before it is interpolated as a column name into `entity.${key}` inside a service's findAll; it must be enforced per service because every controller passes @Query() straight through to the service, and no global ValidationPipe, DTO or whitelist exists at the pinned commit.

landing_point.why: The summary names dynamic column names in TypeORM query builders; the article list builder is the largest public one (GET /api/article plus the API-key headless route) and is the first site the published fix rewrites.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /api/article (article.controller.ts:57) and GET /api/article/headless/list (article.controller.ts:64-71, ApiKeyGuard read scope)
fix_sites.module_kind: service — NestJS provider, QueryBuilder list filter (content module)
service — QueryBuilder list filter (uploads module, not the content API the report names)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The view builder sits in the traffic-analytics module (and smtp/search in mail and search admin modules) behind JwtAuthGuard, so a solver can argue the advisory is about the public content list API and that these authenticated admin/monitoring lists are a neighbouring feature the report never mentions.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: GET /api/comment?pass=false moderation filtering and GET /api/article?status=draft rely on `pass` and `status` being exact-match equality predicates; they must stay out of the LIKE loop, otherwise the boolean `pass` column (stored 0/1) is compared as `pass LIKE '%false%'` and returns nothing, silently emptying the admin comment queue. Likewise `page`/`pageSize` are not columns and must never reach the LIKE loop or every list endpoint errors.

O6_input_shapes: query key that is not an entity column (e.g. `title) OR 1=1--`) is dropped instead of being interpolated
reserved `page` / `pageSize` numeric keys removed from the LIKE loop
reserved `status` key removed from the LIKE loop (it is an equality filter)
reserved `pass` key removed from the LIKE loop (comment moderation equality filter)
selector key that is a real column name (title, email, hostId, filename, path, ...) still accepted per entity
unknown entity name in the shared helper returns `{}` (fail-closed, no predicates)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/view — @Query() object reaches the view.${key} LIKE sink
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Requires a JWT (view.controller.ts:32) and is presented as internal visit statistics, not a content endpoint.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another module directory (view) and another controller from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/smtp — @Query() object reaches the smtp.${key} LIKE sink
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Mail-log list behind JwtAuthGuard (smtp.controller.ts:30); a solver can call it an internal admin tool unrelated to the reported article search.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another module directory (smtp) plus a mail utility dependency

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/search — @Query() object reaches the search.${key} LIKE sink
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Search-history list behind JwtAuthGuard (search.controller.ts:28) and its entity has no whitelist entry at all in the published fix, so it is easy to treat as out of the fix's scope.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another module directory (search), reached through a different controller

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/user — @Query() object reaches the user.${key} LIKE sink
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: @Roles('admin') plus JwtAuthGuard (user.controller.ts:33-37), so an admin-only listing is the classic 'already privileged, therefore not a vulnerability' dismissal.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another module directory (user); also reached internally from comment.service.ts:65 with a literal, which suggests to a solver the method is internal-only

O8b_injection_room.sibling: api-key list builder with an Object.keys(otherParams) LIKE loop for `name`/`enabled`
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is an admin list endpoint like user/smtp, the service already exposes findAll(), and the maintainer's own pattern is copying the same loop into every list service.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: webhook list filtered by `event` through the same dynamic-key LIKE loop
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: findAll() returns every webhook with no filtering; adding an `event`/`enabled` filter is an obvious feature and there are five identical loop copies to copy from.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: category list that filters on a caller-supplied `label`/`value` key interpolated as `category.${key}`
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already reads a query key (`articleStatus`) from @Query(), so extending it to a LIKE filter is a one-line change in the same style as the other five modules.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a whitelist entry that includes a { select: false } column such as article.password (the published fix does list `password` for the article entity)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Whitelists in the fix are generated mechanically from entity column names and TypeORM still admits select:false columns in a LIKE predicate, so the same generation habit yields a hash-oracle sibling.

O9_family: SQL injection through dynamically built SQL identifiers (CWE-89) in TypeORM QueryBuilder LIKE predicates

O10_build.language: TypeScript (NestJS 6 server in server/, Next.js client, Node CLI)
O10_build.toolchain: npm/pnpm workspaces; `nest build` (tsc) + rimraf; jest configured with testRegex .spec.ts$
O10_build.project_tests: None for this area: server/src contains no *.spec.ts files at all, so nothing exercises the list endpoints; the fix adds no tests either.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a shared whitelist helper only to article.service.findAll (the route the report shows) and/or escape or re-parameterise the LIKE value, then stop after testing GET /api/article.

out_of_scope_notes: The same fix commit bundles unrelated hardening outside the CWE-89 protection: an HTML tag/event-handler sanitizer for comment creation (fix.diff:292-332), @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard) on POST /comment (fix.diff:51) and a helmet CSP block in starter.ts (fix.diff:206-222); not pursued.
server/src/modules/user/user.service.ts:17-30 creates an admin account from ADMIN_USER/ADMIN_PASSWD defaults ('admin'/'admin') at boot — a different weakness, not pursued.

server/src/modules/article/article.entity.ts:72-74 marks the article password column select:false, yet the published whitelist admits filtering on `password` — noted only as injection room, not pursued.

Whether the four O8 routes still exist in the latest release: no latest checkout or release tree was provided, so present_in_latest is unknown for all.

Whether the docs bullet 'SQL Injection Prevention - Through TypeORM parameterized queries' (docs/i18n/en/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/tutorial-extras/server-package.md:132) counts as protection_documented_without_exceptions; it speaks about parameterised values, not dynamic column names, so the flag was left off.

Input shapes the fix does not normalise: array-valued query params (`?title[]=a&title[]=b`) pass the whitelist for a valid key and are interpolated as 'a,b'; nested object keys (`?a[b]=c`) are dropped because the key 'a[b]' is not in the list.
